meta.title: A withdrawn event's status and remark are persisted

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event the QA vendor bid on, closed, and awarded to that vendor (award submitted for approval).
steps: The buyer sends the request that updates (and publishes) the event, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
As the buyer, read the event and check that “status” equals the status sent in step 1; “withdraw details” is not empty.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: “status” equals the status sent in step 1; “withdraw details” is not empty.
